name: sg_suppressions_add
description: Add an email address to a suppression (unsubscribe) group and increment the group's unsubscribe count. Adding an address that is already suppressed in the group is a no-op. (POST /v3/asm/groups/{group_id}/suppressions)

group_id.description: The ID of the unsubscribe group the email address should be added to.

email.description: The email address to add to the unsubscribe group.
